status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.disk_almost_full_title: The disk of the indexer is almost full
status.disk_almost_full_description: {percent}% of the disk is used. At 95% the indexer stops writing and the new logs are lost. Free some space, add disk space or lower the log retention in the settings.
status.days_left: Expires today | Expires in {count} day | Expires in {count} days

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_choose_description: Agents connect to this name and check it in the server certificate. Once an agent is enrolled, the name cannot change without updating every agent.
settings.host_bound_helper: Agents are bound to this name. To move the server, restore the backup on the new node and point the DNS record of this name to it.
settings.host_locked_helper: Locked because agents are enrolled. Revoke all agents to change it. To move the server, restore the backup on the new node and point the DNS record of this name to it.
settings.host_locked_by_agents: Agents are enrolled with this host name. Revoke all agents to change it.
settings.cannot_check_agents: Cannot check the enrolled agents, the host name was not changed
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.ldap_domain_tooltip: Users of this domain can log in to the dashboard with their account. Without a domain, only the local administrator can log in.
settings.ldap_readonly_group_helper: Members can read alerts and agents but cannot change anything
settings.same_as_admin_group: Choose a group different from the administrators group
settings.required_with_user_domain: Required when a user domain is chosen
settings.index_unclassified_events_tooltip: Index the logs that no decoder recognizes. They take more disk space and cannot be filtered by field.
settings.retention_days_helper: Events and findings are kept at least this long, then deleted month by month. Check the free disk space before raising it.
settings.retention_days_range: Enter a number of days between 30 and 3650
settings.export_url_helper: Forward the alerts to an external system (SIEM, log collector) as JSON over HTTPS. Leave empty to disable.
settings.export_url_https: The address must start with https://
settings.export_token_helper: Optional. Sent as a bearer token. Leave empty to keep the current one.
settings.password_length: The password must have 12 to 64 characters
settings.password_characters: Only A-Z a-z 0-9 and . , _ + : @ % ^ = ~ - are accepted
settings.password_classes: The password needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol among . , _ + : @ % ^ = ~ -
settings.smarthost_missing_description: Configure the smarthost in the cluster settings to send emails.
settings.notify_recipients_helper: One address per line. A summary of the new findings is sent every 5 minutes.
settings.notify_recipients_invalid: Each line must be a valid email address
settings.notify_sender_helper: Leave empty to use the default. Change it if the smarthost refuses this sender.
settings.notify_sender_invalid: Must be a valid email address
settings.notify_min_level_helper: Only the findings at this level or above are sent, by email and Telegram
settings.telegram_token_helper: Create a bot with BotFather and paste its token. The same bot sends the admin summary and the zone alerts of the customers. Leave empty to keep the current one.
settings.telegram_remove_token_description: Telegram stops for the admin and for every customer, and their chats are cleared. To block the bot itself, revoke the token in BotFather.
settings.telegram_admin_enabled: Send the findings to the admin chat
settings.telegram_chat_id_helper: Add the bot to the group, then click Find chats and pick it.
settings.telegram_no_chats_description: Telegram only keeps the last day. Add the bot to the group again, or send it a message, then click Find chats.
settings.telegram_bot_in_use: Another app or a webhook already reads the messages of this bot, so its chats cannot be listed. Type the chat ID instead, or use a bot for Wazuh only.
settings.telegram_chat_id_invalid: Enter a chat ID like -1001234567890, or a channel like @name
settings.telegram_test_sent: Test message sent. Check the chat.
settings.telegram_token_invalid: Telegram does not know this token
settings.telegram_chat_not_found: Telegram cannot find this chat. Check the ID and that the bot was added to it.
settings.telegram_bot_not_member: The bot cannot write to this chat. Add it to the group, or start a conversation with it.
settings.telegram_rate_limited: Telegram got too many messages. Try again in a minute.
settings.telegram_unreachable: Telegram did not accept the message. Check the network access to api.telegram.org.
settings.telegram_token_pattern: This does not look like a bot token: digits, a colon, then letters
settings.telegram_chat_id_pattern: Enter a chat ID like -1001234567890, or a channel like @name
settings.token_pattern: This does not look like a bot token: digits, a colon, then letters
settings.chat_id_pattern: Enter a chat ID like -1001234567890, or a channel like @name
settings.chat_ids_pattern: Enter a chat ID like -1001234567890, or a channel like @name
settings.export_url_pattern: The address must start with https://
settings.export_token_pattern: The token cannot contain spaces or line breaks
settings.retention_days_minimum: Enter a number of days between 30 and 3650
settings.retention_days_maximum: Enter a number of days between 30 and 3650
settings.notify_recipients_format: Each line must be a valid email address
settings.notify_min_level_enum: Choose a level from the list

agents.title: Agents
agents.ttl_helper: Time to enroll. Enrolled agents stay connected after.
agents.max_uses_helper: Servers that can use this token, 1 to 100.
agents.max_uses_invalid: Must be a number between 1 and 100
agents.customer_helper: Pick a customer or type a new one. It groups its servers in the list and the dashboards, and holds their login zones.
agents.agent_name_helper: Optional. The FQDN of the server when empty, else its host name.
agents.name_invalid: Only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores
agents.container_hint: With the agent container, set this environment variable:
agents.revoke_description: The server forgets the agent and its key stops working. The agent has to enroll again with a new token to send its logs.
agents.linux_command: On a Debian or Red Hat family Linux, run as root:
agents.linux_hint: Installs the agent, enrolls it and starts it.
agents.other_systems: Install the Wazuh 5 agent by hand, then enroll it with this token.
agents.step_command: Run the command as root on the server to watch.
agents.step_check: The agent shows as Active in the Agents tab.
agents.requirement_dns: It resolves the host name of this Wazuh server.
agents.requirement_ports: It reaches TCP ports 1514, 1515 and 1517 here.
agents.requirement_os: Debian, Ubuntu, Rocky, AlmaLinux or RHEL, x86_64 or aarch64.
agents.requirement_logs: The agent reads the system journal.
agents.update_description: {name} runs {from}, the server runs {to}. Run this command as root on {name}: it installs the version of the server and keeps the enrollment, no token is needed.
agents.customer_reserved: This name is reserved, choose another one
agents.change_customer_description: Its customer is now {customer}. The agent keeps its key, no new enrollment is needed. Its new events take the login zones of the new customer. The events already stored keep the old customer.

customers.title: Customers
customers.zones_description: Choose the countries or continents the users of each customer log in from. A successful login from anywhere else raises a finding and an email, once a day per user, address and service. Only public addresses are checked: logins from a LAN or a VPN have no country. A customer without zones is not watched.
customers.no_customers_description: A customer is created with an enrollment token, in the Agents page.
customers.telegram_enabled: Send the zone alerts to Telegram
customers.zones_helper: Empty to stop watching the logins of this customer
customers.recipients_helper: One address per line. They only receive the zone alerts: logins from outside the allowed zones. The other findings go to the Settings recipients.
customers.no_zones_description: These recipients get no alert until a zone is chosen.
customers.telegram_chat_id_helper: Chat of the customer that receives the zone alerts, through the bot set in Settings. Add the bot to the group, then click Find chats and pick it.
customers.telegram_no_token: To send the zone alerts to Telegram too, turn on Telegram and set the bot token in Settings.
customers.telegram_chat_id_pattern: Enter a chat ID like -1001234567890, or a channel like @name
customers.recipients_invalid: Each line must be a valid email address
customers.recipients_format: Each line must be a valid email address
customers.zones_pattern: Choose countries or continents from the list
customers.remove_warning: Its login zones and alert recipients are lost.
customers.remove_description: Only a customer without agents can be removed. The events already stored keep its name.
customers.customer_has_agents: This customer still has agents: move them to another customer first.
